description: Sometimes the greatest of adventures are born from the simplest of ideas. The T Line - 1-speed from Brompton proves that minimalism still encompasses power. Pure in its intentions with expert engineering, this model is the perfect everyday bike for active individuals looking to turn each moment into a carefree adventure. Weighing just 7.45 kgs, you can commute, travel and explore with nothing holding you back. Don't let this fool you though, as the T Line - 1-speed is a powerhouse that performs amazingly every time. Whilst the titanium frame weighs 37% less than traditional all-steel models, this bike is suitable for users of up to 110 kgs! The frame is also incredibly durable, allowing excellent suspension and road performance. If the style is important to you, this stylish Brompton classic will not disappoint. With an ergonomic frame that represents the agile future ahead of you, finishing touches such as the discreet fixings and posture-enhancing handlebars boast a characterful design sure to put a smile on anyone's face. Brompton offers you much more than a new bike; it offers a way of life. Soaring through your day on the T Line - 1-speed will prove that you can go anywhere and experience everything.
